gen-dafont-junegull-gf-miriam-libre: Chunky retro charm up top, with Junegull's pinched curves and tall lowercase standing like cast iron signage. Miriam Libre answers with open, wire-fine letters beneath.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One spreads its sizable letters out with generous gaps. Junegull's retro heading sits over that sans-serif text, and their shared lack of thick-thin swelling is what ties them together.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-montserrat-underl: Friendly and a little retro, Junegull closes its curves tight. Montserrat Underline opens its round bowls wide beneath, and that closed-versus-open difference is the pair's real hook.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-mozilla-headline: Friendly through and through, Junegull draws wirelike strokes in its display lettering. Mozilla Headline follows with big-bodied sans-serif lowercase and a splayed c, so paragraphs of it feel generous and approachable.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text has tall-bodied lowercase that looks bold, with terminals flaring outward. Junegull's pinched, retro heading above it stays closed where the sans-serif text opens up, giving each side a distinct personality.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-nata-sans: Junegull brings retro friendliness, its curves pinched shut and its lowercase standing tall like cast iron. And Nata Sans carries a long passage with a technical-pen steadiness, its wide unclosed curves keeping the lines easy to follow.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-nobile: Nobile keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, with open letter mouths like unjoined chalk arcs. And Junegull's uppercase, built from lines of constant thickness, makes a sturdy retro contrast that stays comfortable across a long passage.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-nokora: Junegull is retro and friendly, with curves pinched nearly shut. Nokora then lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, and its wide-open s keeps a long passage inviting.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Retro and chunky, Junegull pinches every curve nearly shut while its lowercase stands tall as cast iron capitals. Noto Kufi Arabic opens the c wide below it.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans lets its lowercase fill most of the letter height, with a wide-open c. Junegull's retro heading pinches its curves shut above it, so closed and open shapes trade places down the page.
